params.name: fields
params.description: common delimited fields for return fields

params.name: order_by
params.description: which field to order results by

params.name: limit
params.description: number of records to limit response listing by (1000 max)

params.name: absolute_url
params.description: pull the detail for an opinion

params.name: blocked
params.description: Whether the opinion should be blocked from search engines

params.name: citation_count
params.description: The number of times the opinion has been cited by other opinions

params.name: court
params.description: The ID of the court where the opinion was written

params.name: date_filed
params.description: The date the opinion was filed by the court

params.name: date_modified
params.description: The date and time the opinion was last modified

params.name: extracted_by_ocr
params.description: Whether the text of the opinion was extracted from an image using OCR

params.name: precedential_status
params.description: Whether the opinion has precedential value

params.name: time_retrieved
params.description: The date and time the opinion was added to our system
